manual_requirement.question: Have the subscription's public IP addresses been reviewed in an internet-exposure scanner (e.g. Shodan/Censys) for unexpected open services?
manual_requirement.title: Public IP internet-scanner exposure review
manual_requirement.guidance: Export public IPs (az network public-ip list), look each up in an authorized exposure-scanning service and confirm only intended services are reachable.

prowler.azure.network_public_ip_shodan.reason: Prowler queries the third-party Shodan API for each public IP; PEASO is read-only against the cloud provider and does not call third-party internet scanners, so this becomes a reviewer question.
prowler.azure.network_public_ip_shodan.review_notes: Use the native NSG exposure checks for configuration-level evidence.

source_review.native_unit: provider resource in the selected subscription

manual_requirement.question: Are all virtual machines using a desired (approved) VM SKU size?
manual_requirement.title: VMs use approved SKU sizes
manual_requirement.guidance: Compare each VM hardwareProfile.vmSize with the organisation's approved size list, ideally enforced by the 'Allowed virtual machine size SKUs' Azure Policy.

prowler.azure.vm_desired_sku_size.reason: The desired VM size list is organisation-specific (prowler config desired_vm_sku_sizes, default Standard_A8_v2/Standard_DS3_v2/Standard_D4s_v3 placeholders), so it cannot be decided natively without an approved list.
prowler.azure.vm_desired_sku_size.review_notes: Use the Azure Policy 'Allowed virtual machine size SKUs' assignment as evidence.

source_review.native_unit: provider resource in the selected subscription

manual_requirement.question: Are all virtual machines created from organisation-approved machine images?
manual_requirement.title: VMs use approved images
manual_requirement.guidance: Check storageProfile.imageReference (managed image, Compute Gallery image version or Marketplace offer) against the approved golden image catalogue, ideally enforced by the 'Allowed images'/'Approved VM images' Azure Policy.

prowler.azure.vm_ensure_using_approved_i.reason: Prowler counts any managed image id (/providers/Microsoft.Compute/images/) as approved and fails Compute Gallery and Marketplace images, even though its own remediation recommends Compute Gallery golden images. Approval is organisation-specific.
prowler.azure.vm_ensure_using_approved_i.review_notes: Porting prowler literally would FAIL gallery-based golden images.
